# Contraction timer & log

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/contraction-timer/

Record contraction start times, duration and intervals between starts. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Tap Start when a contraction begins and End when it finishes, then export the session log.

## Limits and checks

This is a timing journal. It does not interpret symptoms, diagnose labour or decide when you should seek maternity care.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [NHS — signs of labour](https://www.nhs.uk/pregnancy/labour-and-birth/signs-that-labour-has-begun/)
